input.brief: Sokka saves places I discover in social posts or add manually into named collections, so I can find them when deciding where to go. I can open a saved place on a map.
input.focus: Stop losing places saved across social posts.

capabilities: open a saved place on a map
need: Recover and organize places worth visiting, rather than generic travel scenery.

input.brief: A document reader that imports documents and reads their existing text aloud. The language selector chooses a text-to-speech voice and pronunciation. It does not translate the text.
input.focus: Listen to a document while doing something else.

need: Listen to existing document content through text-to-speech.

input.brief: Splitly lets a group enter shared trip expenses, see who owes whom, and mark debts settled manually.
input.focus: Make shared costs and outstanding balances understandable.

need: Track shared costs and balances, rather than personal investing or payment processing.

input.brief: A houseplant app lets users photograph a leaf, receive possible causes of visible damage, and record watering dates. It gives possible causes, not a guaranteed diagnosis or cure.
input.focus: Understand a damaged leaf before deciding what to check next.

constraints.exclude: No brand logos. Hands-only demonstrations are allowed.

capabilities: suggest possible causes of visible damage
need: Investigate visible plant damage with appropriately uncertain suggestions. Sparse and challenging domain; do not fill with unrelated diagnosis footage.

input.brief: A subscription tracker lets users enter prices and renewal dates manually, receive renewal reminders, and mark a subscription cancelled after cancelling it with the provider. It cannot link banks or cancel subscriptions.
input.focus: See upcoming renewals before forgetting about them.

capabilities: manually enter subscription prices and renewal dates
need: Track renewal dates and make a decision before a renewal.

input.brief: A product photo editor removes a photo background, lets the seller choose a solid color, and adjusts brightness before exporting the image. It does not change the physical product or generate new product details.
input.focus: Turn a cluttered listing photo into a clear product image.

constraints.exclude: No visible faces or full people. Hands-only demonstrations are allowed.

need: Improve an existing product listing photo with the explicitly supported edits.
